items.headline: Weak showing in loss to Carolina
items.text: Shough completed 25 of 35 targets for 187 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He added 25 rushing yards on six carries and was charged with a lost fumble.

items.headline: Career-high receiving yardage tally in win
items.text: McCaffrey rushed 13 times for 62 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 161 yards and two more scores in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday. He also caught a two-point conversion pass.

items.headline: Stymied by Bengals in loss
items.text: Warren rushed seven times for 15 yards and brought in five of six targets for 26 yards in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday night. He committed a fumble recovered by Pittsburgh.

items.headline: Cleared of head injury
items.text: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that London was cleared of a concussion near the end of Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

items.headline: Records game-winning TD in victory
items.text: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

items.headline: Quiet after ankle injury
items.text: Kelce secured both targets for 30 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: Career-high totals in return
items.text: Pickens brought in 11 of 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.

items.headline: Gains 58 yards on three targets
items.text: Kincaid caught two of three targets for 58 yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.

items.headline: Makes little impact in return
items.text: Etienne carried the ball eight times for 14 yards and caught three of five targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.

items.headline: Totals 66 yards, TD behind CMC
items.text: Black rushed 11 times for 53 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys. He added two catches for 13 yards on two targets.

items.headline: Overcomes turnovers in win
items.text: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

items.headline: Needs thumb surgery, IR possible
items.text: Vikings head coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that Addison will require surgery on his thumb and will miss a few weeks, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Two more TD passes
items.text: Rodgers completed 15 of 29 passes for 143 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed two times for minus-1 yard during Sunday's 38-18 loss at Cincinnati.

items.headline: Gets nine touches to Hall's 15
items.text: Allen rushed eight times for 40 yards and caught his only target for six yards in Sunday's 31-12 loss to the Bills.

items.headline: Two TDs despite just five touches
items.text: Kamra rushed two times for four yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers. He added three catches for 10 yards and an additional touchdown on four targets.

items.headline: Spectacular night in win
items.text: Chase brought in 11 of 14 targets for 231 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Cincinnati.

items.headline: Five catches in blowout win
items.text: Bernard caught all five of his targets for 30 yards during Sunday's 27-6 win against Cleveland.

items.headline: Stellar showing in Week 10 win
items.text: Johnson rushed 22 times for 101 yards and brought in six of seven targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: Ruled out for Monday's game
items.text: McConkey (back) won't travel to Baltimore with the Chargers for Monday's game against the Ravens and has been downgraded from questionable to out for Week 10 action.

items.headline: Has 304 yards in last three games
items.text: Gainwell rushed five times for 16 yards and caught all three of his targets for 60 yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Bears.

items.headline: Not on injury report
items.text: Herbert (finger) doesn't appear on the the Chargers' injury report ahead of Monday night's game against the Ravens.

items.headline: Status for Thursday to be determined
items.text: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Sunday that he's "not certain" if Montgomery (groin) will be able to play Thursday against Indianapolis, DJ Bien-Aime of ESPN reports.

items.headline: Leads backfield in win
items.text: White rushed 11 times for 47 yards and brought in one of two targets for five yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

items.headline: Modest numbers in Week 10 loss
items.text: Johnson carried the ball 10 times for 42 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

items.headline: Team-high yardage total in loss
items.text: Douglas brought in three of eight targets for 71 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.

items.headline: Paces pass catchers in win
items.text: Fannin brought in seven of nine targets for 91 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.

items.headline: Two catches in Week 10
items.text: Waller caught two of four targets for 24 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.

items.headline: Ready to play
items.text: Parkinson (ribs) and Tyler Higbee (illness) have been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Cardinals, while fellow tight end Davis Allen (oblique) is listed as questionable, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

items.headline: Expected to progress ahead of Week 11 action
items.text: Coach Kevin O'Connell said Monday that the Vikings expect Hockenson (wrist/chest) to make progress ahead of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Ruled out for rest of Sunday's game
items.text: Waddle (concussion) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

items.headline: Finds end zone in Carolina
items.text: Coleman carried the ball 17 times for 57 yards and a touchdown and caught all four of his targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.

items.headline: Notches first TD in Week 9 win
items.text: Odunze caught four of seven targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers.

items.headline: Ties career high with five TDs in loss
items.text: Prescott completed 30 of 51 passes for 343 yards with five touchdowns and one interception while rushing four times for seven yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday. He also ran for a two-point conversion.

items.headline: Solid numbers in blowout loss
items.text: Robinson rushed 16 times for 71 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: Productive with 24 touches
items.text: Gordon rushed 20 times for 76 and brought in four of five targets for 39 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.

items.headline: Victim of poor QB play again
items.text: Flowers brought in three of six targets for six yards and rushed three times for 17 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

items.headline: Nine catches in reunion with Cousins
items.text: Jefferson caught nine of 13 targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.

items.headline: Gets into end zone in loss
items.text: Metcalf brought in two of six targets for 54 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion catch in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday night.

items.headline: Three grabs in Week 10 win
items.text: Meyers caught three of six targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans.

items.headline: Tosses three TDs in Munich
items.text: Goff completed 20 of 31 passes for 303 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich. He added three yards on his only carry.

items.headline: Shut down by Minnesota
items.text: Kraft caught one of four targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

items.headline: Headed for imaging on ankle
items.text: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said that Cooper (ankle) will undergo imaging Monday, Eric Allen of the team's official site reports.

items.headline: Stymied by Bucs
items.text: Swift rushed 12 times for 31 yards and didn't catch his lone target in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers.

items.headline: Three more TDs in loss
items.text: Stroud completed 20 of 38 passes for 211 yards with three touchdowns and one interception while adding three rushes for 20 yards in the Texans' 27-24 loss to the Browns on Sunday.

items.headline: Not expected to return Week 9
items.text: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Tuesday that Conner (foot) won't return from IR this week, Darren Urban of the team's official site reports.

items.headline: Does just enough to eke out win
items.text: Young completed 17 of 30 passes for 200 yards without a touchdown or interception in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints. He added one rushing yard on his only carry.

items.headline: Breaks off 74-yard rushing TD
items.text: Cook rushed 18 times for 157 yards and a touchdown and didn't catch his only target in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.

items.headline: Leading rusher as Chargers remain winless
items.text: Hampton rushed 13 times for 60 yards and wasn't targeted in Sunday's 44-22 loss to the Texans.

items.headline: Emerges with big line in Week 10 loss
items.text: Flournoy tallied six catches for 71 yards and one touchdown on seven targets during Sunday's loss to San Francisco. He also recovered a fumble.

items.headline: Career-high receiving yardage in loss
items.text: Likely brought in nine of 11 targets for 127 yards and a touchdown and fumbled once but recovered in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

items.headline: Pair of TDs in close loss
items.text: Skattebo rushed 18 times for 78 yards and two touchdowns and brought in three of four targets for 44 yards in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

items.headline: Hits paydirt in Green Bay
items.text: Jones carried the ball 11 times for 47 yards and a touchdown and caught his only target for eight yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.

items.headline: Only one catch in Week 10 defeat
items.text: Douglas caught one of three passes for four yards during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.

items.headline: Five catches in Week 10 win
items.text: Higgins brought in five of six targets for 66 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night.

items.headline: Productive with five catches in win
items.text: Rice brought in five of six targets for 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: Forgettable numbers in win
items.text: Jones completed 11 of 22 passes for 108 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions while adding five carries for nine yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.

items.headline: Keeps rolling in wild Week 10 win
items.text: Purdy completed 22 of 28 passes for 389 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions and added two carries for 21 yards in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday. He also threw a two-point conversion pass.

items.headline: Clears century mark in scrimmage yards
items.text: Taylor rushed 16 times for 83 yards and brought in two of four targets for 20 yards in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Indianapolis.

items.headline: Tops 100 scrimmage yards against Titans
items.text: Tuten carried the ball 26 times for 88 yards and a touchdown and caught three of four targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over Tennessee.

items.headline: Middling production in Week 10 loss
items.text: Nabers secured five of seven targets for 44 yards and lost a fumble in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

items.headline: Limping following loss Sunday
items.text: Brown (hamstring) was spotted walking around with a limp in the locker room following Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, Andrew Callahan of the Boston Herald reports.

items.headline: Next to nothing with three touches
items.text: Warren rushed once for three yards and brought in two of three targets for one yard in the Colts' 24-22 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.

items.headline: Secures three catches in Week 10 win
items.text: Concepcion caught three of eight targets for 21 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over Houston. He also gained six yards on one carry.

items.headline: Not much on five touches in Week 10
items.text: Allgeier mustered five carries for 14 yards and didn't gather in his only target during Sunday's 34-6 defeat to the Rams.

items.headline: Ineffective playing through toe injury
items.text: Boston caught just one pass for 16 yards on two targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.

items.headline: Totals 109 scrimmage yards, two TDs in win
items.text: Samuel rushed three times for 78 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for 31 yards and another score in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday.

items.headline: Two catches in Week 9 loss
items.text: Andrews secured both targets for 19 yards in the Ravens' 33-10 loss to the Jaguars on Thursday night.

items.headline: Not expected to be available after bye
items.text: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that he didn't have a definitive diagnosis for the injury Maye (ankle) sustained in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich, but indicated that the quarterback will miss time," Phil Perry of NBC Sports Boston reports. "I wouldn't imagine him being available coming out of the [Week 11] bye," Vrabel said.
